1995.kid: From the mast, a line runs to the controller box and on to the mobile company’s big switch. A GSM call is so small that four of them share one little slot on the line.
1995.nerd: Abis (mast → BSC) and Ater (BSC → transcoder): E1 lines, 32 timeslots of 64 kbit/s. A call takes a 16 kbit/s quarter of one; slot 1 carries the mast’s signalling (LAPD). Many networks (Nokia, Siemens) put the transcoder (TRAU) at the MSC, so the quarters went all the way there; at the TRAU the data is rate-adapted into a whole 64 kbit/s slot, as V.110 does.
